rv.q: Both radical and relevant, STUFFED both entertains and provides plenty of food for thought.
Ugly Bucket masterfully uses fast-paced clowning and high-energy physical theatre to translate these heavy, verbatim testimonies into a visceral, visually arresting experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this physical theater piece about food insecurity for its innovative structure that feeds audiences before the performance, creating powerful collective experience through clowning and connection.
